plan.human_controls: Record whether positive interface recovery and presumed-negative confidence behavior persist on both human conformations. Failure makes mouse interpretation additionally confounded.
plan.mouse_controls: No known mouse-binding positive control is available in this panel; human control labels do NOT transfer to mouse.
plan.selection: Same target-integrity filter and confidence selection; no alternate seeds. Report all three samples.
plan.no_binary_crossreactivity_call: Neither high nor low predicted scores establish or rule out mouse binding. AF monomer targets have no experimentally validated bound conformation or full glycan/dimer screen here.

limitations: One seed and three samples per condition
Mouse reference binder pose is transferred from human; not experimental
AlphaFold monomer is not an experimentally validated bound/dimer/glycosylated target
No mouse affinity or cross-reactivity claim; low confidence cannot establish nonbinding
